_comment: Canonical environment configuration for the prod deployment. Both provision.sh and deploy.sh
pass this file to every az deployment, so a redeploy can never silently reapply a Bicep
default for a setting an operator configured here.
Deliberately absent because they are release-specific and supplied on the command line:
Deliberately absent because they are secrets held in Key Vault:
the connector API key, the eBay client id and client secret, and the eBay marketplace
Account-specific values such as alert recipients belong in the gitignored overlay
infra/parameters/prod.local.parameters.json, which is layered on top of this file.
